reference.title: Application Integration
reference.shortdesc: The APIs are integrated with the web and mobile application dashboard:

section.p: The APIs are integrated with the web and mobile application dashboard:

ul.li: Web Application Dashboard: Provides a real-time visualization of motor attributes and alerts.
Mobile Application Dashboard: Provides portable access to motor attributes and alerts, empowering field engineers to make informed decisions swiftly.

section.p: See the Web and Mobile Application User Guide for more information on the web and mobile application dashboards.
